usedFor: Anyone who messages Ricky gets a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Created” in Ricky, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A contact appears with a first message or through the API, the first sign of interest.

watchOut: “Updated Contact” fires on every save, so it would make a second HubSpot deal for the same person.
